modernity.evidence: Flat design with rounded cards and pill buttons on a warm sand background; contemporary sans-serif type.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Large bold headline, short lead, then one coral button; info cards sit clearly below the hero.

mobile_usability.evidence: Mobile collapses to one column with a full-width booking button; header keeps only logo and Réserver.

readability.evidence: Dark text on cream with generous line height; body copy comfortably sized on both viewports.

imagery_quality.evidence: Illustrated beach scene with a plate and fish graphic; tidy but abstract, no real food photography.

trust_signals.evidence: Five gold stars with 4,8/5 and 320 reviews, "depuis 2009", plus hours, address and phone cards.

cta_clarity.evidence: Coral "Réserver une table" button in the hero, repeated as a "Réserver" button in the header.

brand_consistency.evidence: Teal and coral logo colors reused in headings, buttons and the illustration throughout.

summary.en: Modern, well-structured restaurant homepage with a prominent booking button, visible reviews and a clean mobile layout. Only the illustrated hero lacks real food photos.
summary.fr: Page d'accueil moderne et bien structurée, avec un bouton de réservation très visible, des avis affichés et une version mobile propre. Seule l'illustration remplace de vraies photos des plats.
